title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00389011507650 (+0.26255722% over #8026) from paired P104 suppliers
body:
## Result

The proposed fixed-multitape multiplier for arbitrary binary integers attains **conditional κ ≥ 0.00389011507650**. A submission-time check of canonical main and all 1,314 open PRs gave **0.00387992804541** as the strongest complete comparator. The absolute increase is **0.00001018703109**, or **0.2625572168%** relative to that bound. Main at `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` selects 0.00363005817. [Comparator at its checked head](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/156137f70e7819cca8d86a1925d4c2873c77552e/research/bit-451-carrier-cover) · [Selected record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/certificates/selected-result.json)

## Construction and evidence

The 111-port binary circuit returns 408 independent helper fields, including 17 grade-four returns. It uses 2,803 paid transfers per call. Its literal forward and reverse checks cover all 630 inputs and outputs. Pricing all 36 calls and compiling their finite product gives an ordinary BIT cap of **0.003890115076583**. [Construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4/research/p104-live-relative-gain/README.md) · [Finite receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4/research/p104-live-relative-gain/APPLICATION.json)

The rational circuit has 1,291 independent public fields and 5,674 paid transfers per call. Two helper splits and three final bank changes preserve the required output at every address. The forward check visits 25,146,238 rational scalar products. The adjoint check visits 88,780,788 terms. The full 48-call rational crossing is between **0.00389848144654** and **0.00389848144655**. The ordinary BIT supplier limits the combined exponent. [Bank changes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4/research/p104-live-relative-gain/BANK-FACTORS-EVENTS.json) · [Rational replay receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4/research/p104-live-relative-gain/BANK-FACTORS-RECEIPT.json)

## Replay

Run the registered package with CPython 3.12. The checks use the standard library and 134 pinned source files supplied in the package.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-live-relative-gain
```

The independent reader reconstructs the product grid, the ordinary work, the signed invoices and the outer application. All 54 strict and four functional conditions pass. The smallest strict margin is 10⁻¹⁵. To retain the physical receipt, run `verify_application.py --out FILE` with CPython 3.12. [Replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4/research/p104-live-relative-gain/verify_application.py)

## Assumptions and credit

The complete exponent inherits five premises concerning native operators on all columns, owned erasure, the all-size compiler, tape precision and analytic recovery. Independent scientific review of the changed application remains open. [Inherited framework](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af/research/p104-iterated-returns/continuation)

Ali Romman prepared the two circuits and the combined replay with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Clear1nsight supplied predecessor circuits, the finite compiler and the independent scalar audit. The binary construction uses the punctured E8 supplier and the serializer retained in #7912. The earlier work credits DreamingOfClouds, Jerry Chen (CubeJerry), zxv, Dugongue, SYLforge, Rohan Arun, Cinna Davis, Douglas Colkitt and the contributors in the retained notices. ToikY supplied the live comparison in #8026.
